**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent's king moves to an exposed square like c6, look for rook checks that push it further away. Here, Rc1+ forces the king into a mating net on the queenside. The quiet follow-up Rc5 pins and attacks the a6 pawn, leaving Black helpless. Always consider how checks and quiet moves together can create inescapable traps.
